message:
deploy checks failed in the 'production' environment:
  loom.rest.E001: the API authenticates no caller: neither jwt nor 'custom: true' is set in app.rest.auth. Hint: configure app.rest.auth.jwt, or set 'app.rest.auth.custom: true' and pass create_app(authenticator=...); list loom.rest.E001 under checks.silenced only when a gateway in front authenticates every request.
  loom.cursors.E001: stores.settings.cursors.signing is 'unknown': cursor tokens are not signed with a key every instance shares. Hint: drop stores.settings.cursors.signing from the deployed configuration (signed is the default) and set stores.settings.cursors.current_key_id and stores.settings.cursors.keys, each key read from a mounted file (path) or an injected secret variable (env).
Deploy checks run in production and staging; LOOM_ENV unset means production. For local work set LOOM_ENV=development. To accept a finding on purpose, list its id under checks.silenced.
